title: Slovakian Pork Belly Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy dish originating from Slovakia, featuring marinated pork belly skewers grilled to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together garlic, onion, red pepper flakes, honey, apple cider vinegar, and olive oil.
Add the pork belly cubes to the marinade and mix well.
Thread the marinated pork belly onto skewers.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the internal temperature reaches 160°F (71°C).
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
